drafts.subject: Bulldog tee
drafts.body:
Dear Tauhid,
We are sorry, but size S is currently out of stock.
From our New Haven shop, we can offer M (5 on the shelf), L (3), or XL (2) now.
If you prefer S, we can place you on a waitlist; the vendor's five-day lead time begins only after its outstanding invoice is paid, and that payment is awaiting approval.
Would you prefer an available size or the size S waitlist?
With warm regards,
Campus Customs

drafts.subject: Your hoodie order
drafts.body:
Good afternoon, Yale AI Club,
We have 8 CC-HOOD-NAVY hoodies in size M on the shelf; S (4), L (14), and XL (6) are also available if members would consider another size.
The student-group price is $52.20 each ($1,044 for all 20), with student ID checked at pickup.
A full order would require a $522 deposit received before restocking; we cannot recommend the 12-unit M restock now, as rent and the overdue invoice would leave $160 in cash, below our $500 reserve.
If you prefer to wait for M, Bulldog Print Co's five-day lead time begins only after invoice 501 is paid, so we cannot offer a fixed date.
We would be honored to design a capsule for your club, and our staff would be glad to arrange a private consultation.
Would you prefer the eight M hoodies with available alternate sizes, or to wait for the M restock?
With warm regards,
Campus Customs
